_comment: Kansas 2026 QAP, Kansas Housing Resources Corporation. Page numbers are PDF page indices; the printed page number is three lower. THREE UNIVERSES. (1) 9% new construction, Section VII (pp.24-37), the default track. (2) 4% applications scored on the same Section VII criteria against a 55-point minimum; the p.24 chart marks which apply. They are not duplicated here: A.2, E, G and K.4 are 9% only, and K.5 is 4% only (track four_pct). (3) Rehabilitation, Section VI (p.23): six ranked priorities and no points (track rehab). Every application must also earn all 310 Appendix A (K.A.R. 110-10-1) points, coded as thresholds. NO TOTAL IS STATED for Section VII. Hand-summed before loading from the section maxima: A 10 (5 + 5), B/C 10, D 5, E 5, F 20 (10 + 10), G 30 (10 + 20), H/I 15, J 10, K 20 (5 + 15) = 125. Each stated section maximum ('Maximum of N points') matches its parts. The loader matched 125. Deductions of up to 30 are excluded. The 4% maximum from the chart is 85 (A.1 5, B/C 10, D 5, F 20, H/I 15, J 10, K 20), a computed figure not reconciled by the loader.

track_totals.note: 9% new construction. No total stated. Computed 125 from the section maxima. Preliminary applications must reach 33 points to be invited to full application (p.24).

4% applications are scored on the Section VII criteria the p.24 chart marks for 4% and must reach 55 points. Only K.5, the one 4%-only criterion, is coded on this track; the shared criteria sit on the default track and are not duplicated. Computed 4% maximum 85; not reconciled.
Rehabilitation: six ranked priorities, no point scoring (p.24).

criteria.heading: Past Performance
criteria.quote: KHRC will award 1 point for each Kansas LIHTC property up to 5 points

tiers.tier_label: In-state: 1 point per Kansas LIHTC property placed in service 2016-2025 (up to 5)
Out-of-state: 3 properties placed in service outside Kansas 2016-2025

criteria.note: In-state and out-of-state do not combine; KHRC awards the higher. Under the 'Maximum of 10 points' heading for Previous Experience (A.1 + A.2). Scored for 4% and 9%.

criteria.heading: Successful Below Market Loans and Support
criteria.quote: KHRC will award 5 points if the Applicant meets at least 2 of any of the criteria below for Kansas LIHTC
criteria.note: At least two of: below market loans or support, a local fee waiver ($40,000 Metropolitan, $20,000 Rural, or 100%), a 10-year real estate tax exemption, or Inflation Reduction Act rebates, on prior Kansas properties. 9% only per the p.24 chart.

criteria.heading: Penalties: Housing Development
criteria.quote: KHRC may deduct 10 points if any Principal was listed as a developer or ownership entity member or
criteria.note: For a development placed in service 2016-2025 whose Principal failed QAP IX(A), sought a qualified contract after September 1, 2022, missed design, accessibility or energy requirements, requested late added resources, increased credits or bonds more than 10%, or missed cost certification. Discretionary ('may').

criteria.heading: Penalties: Housing Compliance
criteria.quote: KHRC may deduct up to 20 points if any Principal was listed as a developer or ownership entity member

tiers.tier_label: Unnotified management or ownership change after January 1, 2023
LURA commitment violation (per violation per property)

criteria.note: Up to -20 in total.

criteria.heading: Underserved Areas
criteria.quote: An area is determined as underserved if it is not in a zip code that has been awarded a LIHTC project in
criteria.note: 10 points for a site outside the listed ZIP Codes: 33 Metropolitan (p.27) and 31 Rural (p.28). Not combinable with Subsequent Phase.

criteria.heading: Subsequent Phase
criteria.quote: is/are within .25 miles of the previous phase(s).
criteria.note: Second or third phase by the same Applicant; earlier phases under 5% vacancy with waitlists of at least half the new units and no qualified contract.

criteria.heading: Residential Character
criteria.quote: KHRC will award 5 points if the proposed site is in or adjacent to existing residential development.

criteria.heading: Quality Site
criteria.quote: KHRC will award 5 points each to up to two proposals in the Metropolitan Counties and two proposals in
criteria.note: Staff's subjective rating of the most desirable sites; at most two per region. 9% only.

criteria.heading: Proximity to Amenities: Primary
criteria.quote: award the maximum points (10 points) to the application with the lowest total mileage; and
criteria.note: Weighted driving distance: grocery x 0.5 + shopping x 0.75 + pharmacy x 1, with a 0.3-mile floor; the lowest total in the region gets 10 and others a percentage of it. 4% applications are compared against 0.4 miles. Under the 'Maximum of 20 points' heading for F.

criteria.heading: Proximity to Amenities: Secondary
criteria.quote: A maximum of 10 points total may be awarded for Secondary amenities.

tiers.tier_label: Per qualifying amenity type within 3 miles driving distance (16 types listed)
Rural Counties: per qualifying amenity 3-20 miles

criteria.note: One point per listed amenity type, distinct from primary amenity establishments. The town square type applies only in Rural Counties.

criteria.heading: Below Market Loans
criteria.quote: KHRC will award up to 10 points to applications meeting the criteria below.
criteria.note: Loans at no more than 1% interest with at least 20-year amortization, or grants, from listed sources. 9% only. Under the 'Maximum of 30 points' heading for G.

criteria.heading: Other Support
criteria.quote: KHRC will award up to 20 points to applications meeting the criteria below. Applicants will earn 10

tiers.tier_label: Land donation by a local government (land and building costs no more than $5,000)
Local fee waiver: 5 or 10 points by unit count and amount, or 10 for a 100% waiver
Kansas sales tax exemption via Industrial Revenue Bonds resolution

criteria.note: 10 points per category, once per category, capped at 20; the fee waiver can also earn 5 ($20,000/$40,000/$60,000 for 0-30/31-100/101+ units, against $40,000/$80,000/$120,000 for 10). 9% only.

criteria.heading: Community Revitalization Plans (CRP)
criteria.quote: KHRC will award an additional 10 points if either the:

tiers.tier_label: Site in a formally adopted Community Revitalization Plan area with local non-housing investment
Additionally: CRP area includes part of a QCT, or the local government selected a Principal by RFP/RFQ

criteria.note: Not combinable with Opportunity Sites; KHRC awards the higher.

criteria.heading: Opportunity Sites
criteria.quote: award the maximum points (15 points) to the application with the highest final percentile ranking;
criteria.note: 9%: the highest Appendix D tract score in the set-aside gets 15, others a percentage of it. 4%: 15 for a score above 70, otherwise a percentage of 70.

criteria.heading: Senior Housing with Services
criteria.quote: Senior developments that commit to at least three of the following will receive 5 points:
criteria.note: Three of eleven listed amenities or services.

criteria.quote: bedrooms will receive 10 points.
criteria.note: Family property with at least 25% of LIHTC units of three or more bedrooms. The J header reads 'Maximum of 10 points'; the bar against combining uses the subsection titles.

criteria.quote: units to be set-aside for households at 30% AMI will receive 5 points.
criteria.note: Metropolitan Counties only: an additional 15% of LIHTC units at 30% AMI beyond Section V targeting. Rural applications cannot earn this, so their K maximum is 15.

criteria.heading: Fair Market Rents
criteria.quote: Development offers gross rent for all units up to and including the 60% limits at a rate that is at or
criteria.note: All rents up to the 60% limits at or below HUD Fair Market Rent. The QAP states the 15 once, for 'one of the four subsections', not per subsection.

criteria.heading: Project Based Rental Assistance
criteria.quote: Development offers project based rental assistance to 60% or more of the LIHTC units.
criteria.note: A local PHA commitment is required at full application. The QAP states the 15 once, for 'one of the four subsections', not per subsection.

criteria.heading: Conversion to Homeownership
criteria.quote: To be eligible for homeownership conversion projects must meet the requirements specified in Section
criteria.note: Single-family homes with a nonprofit sole managing member and a Homeownership Conversion Plan (Section V(C)(6)). 9% only. The QAP states the 15 once, for 'one of the four subsections', not per subsection.

criteria.heading: State Set-Aside Income and Rent Targeting
criteria.quote: Scored at full application for 4% proposals only.
criteria.note: 4% only: the Section V(C)(5) 9% targeting (average 54%/57% AMI, or 30% of units at 40%/50% AMI) taken on voluntarily. The fourth of the 'one of the four subsections' worth 15.

criteria.heading: Best location, higher energy standards, fewer LIHTCs, most 30% AMI units
criteria.quote: KHRC will make awards based on which site(s) is/are the best location
criteria.note: Four considerations applied together 'all in KHRC's discretion', not in stated order. 9% only.

criteria.note: Rehabilitation applications are ranked on six factors 'listed in declining order of significance'; 'Implementation of this subsection will not involve point scoring' (p.24).
